claim: Patchline ships a governance bus-factor proof with documented succession and term limits. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the bus-factor proof claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make governance-bus-factor-proof-gate`.
